summary: The exists test checks whether a path exists on the controller, following symlinks; use link or link_exists to test the link itself.
questions: How do I check if a file exists on the control node in a condition?
Does the exists test follow symlinks?
How do I check a broken symlink exists?
Does exists check the remote host?

answer_card.title: exists test (controller paths)
answer_card.answer_md: `path is exists` is true if the path exists on the **controller**, following symlinks to the target. To check the link itself, use `link` or `link_exists`. For remote paths use `stat`.
